answer: Require one tuition-paying university student status per identity, verified against the enrollment register and a tuition receipt: one student, one seat, one fee of about $500 a semester. The student must attend from dawn lectures to the terrace study hall, and no sonnet of excuses replaces a transcript. Each fake needs a real student paying real tuition, so 100 fakes cost about $50,000 every term, and the bill grows with every fake added.
